commands.blocking_environment: The local sandbox cannot install the Chromium bundle and Nitro dev-worker socket creation is denied. CI installs Chromium and runs the same test file.

source_assertions: Home, issue index, issue detail and article handoff are SSR Nuxt routes consuming only the generated API client.
The pages render semantic Home -> Issue -> article anchors before hydration, have empty/error/not-found states and reserve a 3:4 cover geometry.
The browser suite sets a 375px viewport, reduced-motion preference, no-JavaScript context and axe accessibility scan.
Canonical, Open Graph and JSON-LD data is generated with script-context escaping; the sitemap emits only public Issue routes and robots blocks API plus the intentionally incomplete article shell.
Small text uses the reviewed high-contrast accent/muted tokens and no animation runtime is introduced.
remaining_required_proof: Exact-head Playwright Chromium run including axe assertions and no-horizontal-overflow checks.
next_action: Read CI's Public magazine browser verification result for the final P2 web proof.
